objects.title: A New Life in Equestria
objects.text:
An Interactive CYOA


Welcome to the magical land of Equestria, a land of sunshine and rainbows (literally in some places), populated by many magical creatures and
ruled by Princess Celestia. Even though Equestria is a peaceful land, dangers and villains do exist, and while you can live a life of (relative) peace here, there is plenty of room for excitement and adventure.

You will start off with 100 points.

objects.title: Entry
objects.text: How do you wish to enter Equestria? Be warned, some combination of choices may be dangerous.

objects.title: Reborn
objects.text: You will be reborn into the world. If you chose different age than "newborn" in the age section, then that will be the age you become "conscious". Basically, that will be moment you get your memories back. Don't worry, you will still have memories of what you were doing before "awakening", so your family don't think you were suddenly struck with a case of amnesia.

objects.title: Drop-In
objects.text:
You will be entered into the world after you made all your choices. You will have no identity in Equestria.

This comes with a basic set of clothing if you choose Anthropomorphic, Humanized, or a race that wears clothing.

objects.title: Established
objects.text:
This is kind of a mix of Reborn and Drop-In

You get a paper trail proving that you exist, as well as extra stuff like a home and such, but you don't get a family or friends. You also get some basic knowledge, so you know how to act and fit in with your new life. 

If you chose "Newborn" as your age, then the only thing that makes it different from "Reborn" is that you are an orphan.

objects.title: Race
objects.text: Alright, races, there is a lot of them. Some small, some big, some use magic, some breath fire. Anyway, time to make a choice.

objects.title: Earth Pony
objects.text: Earth Ponies are the basic subspecies of ponies. Their natural magic makes them exceptionally strong and durable, and they also have an affinity for the earth and growing plants.

objects.title: Pegasus
objects.text: The strength of the Pegasi comes from their wings. They can fly, stand on clouds, even manipulate weather to some extent. The fastest of them are rumored to even break the sound barrier.

objects.title: Unicorn
objects.text: Unicorns... They are not as strong as Earth Ponies, nor can they fly like the Pegasi, but their strength lays somewhere else. Their magic is more... direct. They can weave magic into spells with a myriad of effect, from simple levitation to teleportation.

objects.title: Thestral
objects.text: Thestrals, also often called bat ponies, are the nocturnal cousins of Pegasi. They are not as fast the Pegasi, but their leathery wings grant them amazing maneuverability. They also possess much better hearing and the ability to see in the dark.

objects.title: Kirin
objects.text: Kirins are another distant cousin of Ponies, and they may have also some connections to Dragons. They can use magic like the unicorns. Kirin when angered can burst into flame and transform into their darker form known as Nirik.

objects.title: Crystal Pony
objects.text:
Crystal Ponies are yet another cousin of the Ponies and are the result of an ancient tribe of Earth Ponies who focused their magics heavily towards the crystals they later resembled. Crystal Ponies have the strength of Earth Ponies, along with an increased toughness. However, they no longer have an affinity towards plant life, being entirely focused on the earth and crystals.

You will draw a lot of attention if you choose a time when the Crystal Empire is missing.

objects.title: Zebra
objects.text: An uncommon sight these days, Zebra come from distant and wild place known as The Savanna. With deep spiritualistic and tribal roots, they often take up professions in alchemy. With their natural resistance to poisons, they are better able to safely create potions.

objects.title: Hippogriff
objects.text: Hippogriffs are the results of Griffons mating with Ponies, which later on resulted in them becoming an entirely new kingdom. They are very similar to Pegasi in their abilities, and they also have the added bonus that their front appendages are equipped with talons which helps with grasping things. If you want a semblance of a hand, then here you go.

objects.title: Griffin
objects.text: Griffins were once a fierce and respected species, but after the collapse of their empire, most of them turned greedy, rude, and often violent. They are great fliers, with strength to back it up. They also have improved sight, one of the best of all the species.

objects.title: Deer
objects.text: The Deer are a very isolated species, preferring to keep themselves to their sacred forests. They can use magic similarly to the Unicorns and Earth Ponies. Their magic is much more nature oriented and because of this all their elemental spells are twice as potent.

objects.title: Minotaur
objects.text: Minotaurs, from The Island of Minos, are a species possessing great strength and durability, much greater than that of an Earth Pony. They are rather traditional in their beliefs and respect strength above all else.

objects.title: Diamond Dog
objects.text:
Diamond Dogs are another fallen race. They once had a great underground kingdom, but that was very, very long ago. Now they are scattered in "packs" and are mostly thieves, slavers, and bandits obsessed with gems. 

Nonetheless, they are great diggers, their claws easily parting earth and rock alike. They also have great sense of smell and hearing. Unfortunately, their intelligence is a bit... lacking.

objects.title: Changeling
objects.text:
Changeling are an insectoid race that feeds on emotions, mostly love as it's the most potent source of nutrients for them. They also have the ability to shapeshift into other species that they observed, although prolonged use of the ability can be draining. 

They are often regarded as parasites and mostly disliked if not openly hated by other races, though this may differ depending on when you enter Equestria.

You may choose to be either an original changeling or a "reformed" changeling.

objects.title: Changeling Queen
objects.text:
Changeling Queens are the leaders of the Changeling race. Much like when comparing Alicorns to normal ponies, Changeling Queens are much more powerful than normal changelings. They possess greater size, strength, speed, durability, and magical prowess over their normal brethren.

You may choose to be either an original changeling or a "reformed" changeling.

objects.title: Siren
objects.text:
Ancient part equine part fish creatures whose music-based magics have made them known for singing travelers to their graves and dominating the minds of sailors. 

Three of their kind were notable for almost conquering Equestria before getting banished to another realm by Starswirl the Bearded. 

Unlike what you may think, they actually can travel on land by hovering over the ground.

Sirens have been known to empower themselves by feeding off the negative emotions of others.

objects.title: Dragon
objects.text: A powerful race. Not many can stand against a fully grown Dragon. Their scales are extremely strong and fireproof, with age gaining a resistance to magic. The breath of a fully grown Dragon can melt steel, and their claws can cut stone. You don't want to mess with an angry Dragon... You don't want to mess with a Dragon, period.

objects.title: Alicorn
objects.text:
Alicorns are less a living creatures and more living embodiments of an aspect of the universe. Possessing the magics of all three Pony tribes, Alicorns are inherently immortal and can eventually recover from any injury or illness that doesn't directly kill them.

You will, of course, start off as a very minor Alicorn only somewhat more capable than a mundane pony. It will take centuries in order to achieve a level of power similar to Celestia or Luna.

objects.title: Draconequus
objects.text:
Draconequui are a special case. Immortal spirit creatures, they are some of the strongest beings in the world. There is only one remaining at the moment: Discord, the spirit of chaos. However, with a bit of a push, you can become one as well. 

The magic of Draconequui is special. It doesn't work the same as other races. Draconequui operate on "principles". Every Draconequus has their own principle. Discord is the principle of Chaos. The principle of a Draconequus shapes their magic and even appearance. Almost anything can be a principle: Chaos, Order, Fire, Earth, Air, Water, Magic, Nature, and many, many others. 

But be warned, a new Draconequus is bound to gain attention.

objects.title: Age
objects.text: How old you want to be? Wanna start from the beginning as a little baby? Maybe be a teen? Or already an adult? Be warned though, if you choose to be on the... ehm... older side and don't have some longevity or immortality, well, your journey may be over sooner than anticipated.

objects.title: Newborn
objects.text:
A newborn, just be warned, you keep your mind. 

If you choose this and don't choose a family start in the next section, you will be found by someone who will take care of you until you can take care of yourself.

objects.title: Foal
objects.text: Somewhere between 5-11 years old by human standards. If you don't have parents and depending on your species, someone may get worried when they see a foal walking around without their parents.

objects.title: Teen
objects.text: Somewhere between 12-18 years old by human standards. Probably no one will give you trouble if you are walking around alone. Well, unless you walk around some shady places, but that's a bit different kind of trouble.

objects.title: Adult
objects.text: Around 19-30 years old by human standard. You can legally drink alcohol and do other adult stuff. Probably the safest choice.

objects.title: Old
objects.text: Around 60-70+ years old by human standard. Are you sure about that? Your journey may end sooner than you would like.

objects.title: Gender
objects.text: Since we have to build you a new body, you must now choose the gender you will be in your new life. Considering it may not be your old gender, we will do you the favor of adapting your gender identity to match.

objects.title: Stallion
objects.text: You are the male representation of your species.

objects.title: Mare
objects.text: You are the female representation of your species.

objects.title: Build
objects.text: Here you can choose the physical style of your new body. While this can be changed with extended effort, your choice will be the default state towards which your new body will gravitate.

objects.title: Slim
objects.text: You are slim, not much muscle, if any. Your slender legs make you look taller.

objects.title: Balanced
objects.text: Not too slim, with almost no noticeable muscles. A good balance.

objects.title: Athletic
objects.text: A slim build with noticeable muscles, something you would see in athletes or swimmers.

objects.title: Strong
objects.text: A strong build, with very noticeable muscles. Typically seen in manual laborers or in the gym.

objects.title: Ripped
objects.text: Muscles on muscles. Typically seen in body builders. Reduces flexibility, however.

objects.title: Family
objects.text: Now you will choose the nature of your new family.

objects.title: Orphan
objects.text: Oh you poor dear. You have no one...

objects.title: Poor Family
objects.text: Your family is rather poor, but you can push thought it. At least you have each other.

objects.title: Middle Class
objects.text: Your family may not be rich, but it's not poor either, a comfortable middle ground.

objects.title: Rich
objects.text: That's a lot of money... If your family isn't from a noble house, they have enough bits to act like one anyway.

objects.title: Job
objects.text:
What job do you want to take in your new life? 

Choosing a job will grant you a decent level of knowledge and skill in the occupation. Taking a similar perk will increase your effectiveness in your new career.

You may only take one.

objects.title: Royal Guard
objects.text:
You are a part of the royal guard.

Your job is to protect Equestria and the princesses. Good luck soldier.

objects.title: Noble
objects.text: By blood or not, you are a part of the Nobility. It's a difficult job, or at least the nobles of Canterlot seem to think so...

objects.title: Mercenary
objects.text: You are a mercenary, a soldier of fortune. You work for the highest bidder. The best part is, that you work by your own rules.

objects.title: Thief
objects.text: You take what you want. The money of others is money of yours. Just make sure not to get caught, alright?

objects.title: Traveler
objects.text: You are a traveler, a jack of all trades. The road is your home. Traveling from town to town you do some odd jobs here and there. It doesn't pay all that well, but you will at least see a lot of new places.

objects.title: Investigator
objects.text:
From uncovering secrets, exposing conspiracies, to discovering the truth, you make your living as an investigator. You might be a private detective, a reporter, or even a researcher. 

But be warned, some truths can be dangerous.

objects.title: Adventurer
objects.text: You are an adventurer, you live on the adrenaline. You explore forgotten ruins in search of ancient artifacts. Maybe you will be the next Daring Do?

objects.title: Entertainer
objects.text: You love making a spectacle of yourself. Be it as a singer, dancer, actor, or even as a stage magician, you are the center of attention.

objects.title: Mailpony
objects.text: You carry letters to ponies. No matter the weather, no matter the danger, letters must be delivered. You are the Mailpony, or creature, depends on what you are really.

objects.title: Laborer
objects.text:
You work manual labor. This could be as a construction worker, painter, plumber, or similar.

The pay is okay and it's an honest work. And hey, you may get some muscles out of it too.

objects.title: Nurse
objects.text: You are a nurse at the local hospital. You take care of the patients and assist the doctors.

objects.title: Farmer
objects.text: You are a farmer, growing produce and tending plants for a living. Not the most exciting job, but it is stable and down-to-earth.

objects.title: Animal Care
objects.text: You make a living tending to animals. You might be a veterinarian, a pet groomer, an animal trainer, or even a beekeeper.

objects.title: Teacher
objects.text: You are a teacher. You work to pass on knowledge and skill to your students. while often unappreciated, this remains one of civilization's most important duties.

objects.title: Cook
objects.text: You cook for a living. This could be as a chef, baker, candy maker, or similar. The pay is decent, and you get the pleasure of seeing the happy smiles on your customers' faces.

objects.title: Carpenter
objects.text: One of the most iconic of craftsponies, a carpenter shapes, joins, and decorates wood into anything from furniture to houses and so much more.

objects.title: Smith
objects.text: A master of the forge, you spend your time heating and shaping metal into weapons, tools, and other various items. A rewarding profession, so long as you can stand the heat.

objects.title: Stonemason
objects.text:
This includes any occupation involving the use and shaping of stone. Create buildings of stone architecture or sculpt marvelous statues.

This includes crystal if you are a Crystal Pony.

objects.title: Textiles
objects.text:
You work with fabric and thread, be it spinning, weaving, sewing, designing, or similar.

While there isn't much call for clothing for most races, cloth is still a vital part of civilized life.

objects.title: Artist
objects.text:
You bring beauty into the world. You might paint a sunset, compose a song, or carve wonderous decorations.

A job tied to the whims of the muses, be it ever so rewarding.

objects.title: Inventor
objects.text: Inspiration and creativity form the hallmarks of the inventor. You focus on creating the new, whether it be a new tool, technique, technology, or even a new magic. A job that can be difficult to make money with, but whose success can net a fortune.

objects.title: Scholar
objects.text: You make your living directly from your knowledge. This can include an accountant's skill in numbers, a historian appraising ancient artifacts, or even a bureaucrat's skill in law and paperwork.

objects.title: Magus
objects.text:
From casting spells to enchanting objects, to studying ancient magics, you make your living from magic. 

A mentally exacting occupation that requires the ability to cast magic.

objects.title: Weatherpony
objects.text:
An occupation unique to ponies. You, along with your fellow weatherponies, are in charge of all weather in Equestria.

Only those with Pegasus magic are capable of this.

objects.title: Time
objects.text:
In which point in the timeline will you enter?
Just be warned... Not all butterflies are nice.

objects.title: Tales of Old
objects.text:
Start your journey before Equestria was... well... Equestria.

The three tribes are constantly at each other's throats, and the cold creeps ever closer...

objects.title: A Thousand Years Ago
objects.text: That was a rather... busy time. Just try not to get stoned, okay?

objects.title: The Prequel
objects.text: Enter Equestria somewhere between 10 to 20 years before the return of Nightmare Moon.

objects.title: The Beginning
objects.text:
The Beginning of the six. The Summer Sun Celebration and the return of Nightmare Moon.

You will enter the day Twilight arrives at Ponyville.

objects.title: The Empire Returns
objects.text: You will enter the day The Crystal Empire returns.

objects.title: The Magic Eater
objects.text: You will enter somewhere between when Tirek started taking magic from ponies and when he fought with Twilight.

objects.title: The Approaching Storm
objects.text: You will enter the day the forces of the Storm King attack Canterlot.

objects.title: Back to School
objects.text: You will enter the day Twilight opens her School of Friendship

objects.title: Age of Harmony and Friendship
objects.text: The Age of Harmony and Friendship is here. With Twilight on the throne and the villains vanquished, there is only peace, at least for now.

objects.title: A Different Time
objects.text: Don't like the options available? That's okay. For a price, this option allows you to enter at a time of your choosing.

objects.title: Location
objects.text: Alright then! So where do you want to be dropped off?

objects.title: Everfree
objects.text:
The Everfree Forest, one of the most dangerous forests in Equestria. Full of different monsters and dangerous plants. Also, the home of a certain Zebra.

While the Castle of The Sisters can be found within, you will not start there.

objects.title: Castle of The Sisters
objects.text: The Castle of Two Sisters is a ruin of a castle from a thousand years ago. It's located in the Everfree Forest, but hey, at least you'll have a roof over your head. The castle was abandoned in a hurry, so some things may have been left behind.

objects.title: Ponyville
objects.text:
A small town bordering Everfree. It's home to a group of six mares wielding the power of The Elements of Harmony.

The citizens of Ponyville are rather friendly, although they can be prone to panic and misunderstandings. So if you are a big dragon or a Draconequus, prepare for some screams of "The Horror! The Horror!"

objects.title: Canterlot
objects.text: Canterlot, the capital of Equestria. Home to... a lot of snobby Unicorns. It's a center of nobility, and the nobility is, well, not the nicest bunch, although there are some exceptions. It's also home to the princesses of the Sun and Moon.

objects.title: Manehattan
objects.text:
A big city very similar to New York

If you prefer city life and don't like to be surrounded by snobby nobility, this could be for you.

It can get a bit pricey around here though.

objects.title: Cloudsdale
objects.text:
Cloudsdale, a city made of clouds.

Most flying races have a natural magic for walking on clouds, Dragons being an exception, but Pegasi are the only ones that can make lasting buildings out of clouds. As such, Cloudsdale is mainly a Pegasus city.

Naturally, only flying races (minus Dragons) may start here.

objects.title: The Crystal Empire
objects.text:
The Crystal Empire, or just the frozen north. Again, it depends on "when".

More a city state than an actual empire, it's the home of Crystal Ponies, and anything crystal oriented. The Empire is protected from the cold winds of the frozen north by the Crystal Heart, a magical artifact that when powered by love of the Empire's citizens creates a force field around the city.

objects.title: Seaquestria/Mount Aris
objects.text:
A nation of Hippogriffs ruled by Queen Novo. Due to historical events, the locals can turn into seaponies. As a result, the city is split between the mountain and underwater.

Don't worry, you will start on dry land.

objects.title: Griffonstone
objects.text: Griffonstone, the capital of the griffon empire, or what's left of it. In this city it's everyone for themselves. Don't expect much help from anyone unless you have the coin.

objects.title: Dragon Lands
objects.text: Unless you are a Dragon, staying here is not recommended. Even as a Dragon, it can be hard. Constant fighting, unbearable heat, and a lot of Dragons are simply jerks. But hey, do as you want.

objects.title: The Changeling Kingdom
objects.text: The Changeling Kingdom in the Badlands. Not much grows here, and the only notable landmark is the Changeling Spire. Overall, not a very friendly place to be. Well, that kinda depends on when you arrive.

objects.title: Somewhere Else...
objects.text: Don't like the choices available? Then for a price, you can make your own choice. The world is a big place, with plenty of opportunities.

objects.title: Reality
objects.text: Reality is a bit of a fickle thing. A world probably exists with all the choices you make here. Can't promise that it will work perfectly.

objects.title: Anthropomorphic
objects.text: Want some familiar shapes? Well, here you go. Those that were already kinda anthropomorphic, like Minotaurs or Centaurs, stay the same. Creatures like Dragons are more human sized but can turn into their "true" form at will.

objects.title: Humanized
objects.text: Even more human! All sapient creatures are basically humans. They keep their abilities and some stuff like wings or horns, and it's your choice if some of them can turn into their "true" forms. Dragons for example.

objects.title: Magic Uncapped
objects.text: Basically, this makes magic much stronger in the world. Mages of Twilight's magnitude are a bit less rare, a couple per generation instead of one in a century. Also, with this, given enough time, other species may also start learning even if they were unable to before.

objects.title: Technology Uncapped
objects.text: Technology in Equestria is a bit weird. On one side they have trains, cameras and cinemas. On the other, they still use carriages, swords and spears. Well, this takes care of that. Invention is a bit more common, and ponies and other creatures are not afraid of change so much. If you are lucky, maybe in a couple of hundred years they will have a fully modern society?

objects.title: Alternate Timeline
objects.text:
Maybe Nightmare Moon won? Maybe Celestia went dark instead of Luna? There are many options.
This one covers them all. Choose what timeline you prefer, and you will be sent there.

objects.title: Swap
objects.text: Want to gender swap a character? Well, here you go! You can swap everyone or just specific characters, the choice is yours.

objects.title: Modern AU
objects.text: This is Equestria, but it's similar to our modern civilization. Cars, planes, TV, phones, etc. Most things run on magic though, so there is no pollution.

objects.title: Equestria at War AU
objects.text:
War never changes. Welcome to Equestria at War, where stakes are high, and costs of production are even higher!

Try not to get shot, okay?

objects.title: Realism
objects.text: How "realistic" do you want the world to be. Because let's be honest, no matter how many villains the show threw at us, it's still a cartoon. The good guys win with maybe a couple of scrapes and bruises at most. Here that's not the case. You have few options.

objects.title: Original
objects.text: The original level of realism, as shown in the cartoon. Everything is sunshine and rainbows (more or less), and the nitty-gritty of real life is somehow hand-waived away.

objects.title: Shaded
objects.text: Everything stays as it is with only couple of changes There is some crime and animals that usually eat meat actually eat meat and death is more acknowledged.

objects.title: Gritty
objects.text: This one goes deeper. There are actual politics going on in the background. War is an actual concern, and so is crime and getting eaten by predators, or attacked by bandits. For example, Ponyville will actually have couple of guards stationed there because of its proximity to the Everfree Forest.

objects.title: Fully Realistic
objects.text: Basically, a general fantasy world but with ponies and all. War can happen, murder can happen, there are politics and bandits. Monsters are more aggressive and can actually kill you. Kinda D&D but with ponies.

objects.title: Perks
objects.text:
Alright, alright! Let's get to the fun stuff. Abilities and powers, this is probably where you spend most of your points. This also doesn't mean that you can't learn the others in the traditional way.

You could naturally train to be faster and stronger or good in combat. You could also study and practice other magic and become as good at them as if you bought them here. This just kinda skips the process of training and learning.

If you are a newborn or a foal, the things you buy here will come in gradually and be fully developed when you turn 15 years old. The knowledge of spells and other things like that will come to you in "flashes" over the years.

objects.title: Special Talent
objects.text:
You are particularly good at one relatively mundane skill or an aspect of the innate magical abilities of your race. Your training and proficiency ceiling in your talent are enhanced.

If you are a pony or another race that gains Cutie Marks, you will gain one in your talent.

objects.title: Advanced Special Talent
objects.text:
Normally a Special Talent, while capable, would be relatively narrow and limited. Not so for you.

Your talent can be as broad as an entire category of skills and abilities, and if you’re an Alicorn or Draconequus you effectively embody such things. 

If you are a pony or another race that gains Cutie Marks, you will gain one in your talent.

objects.title: Magic
objects.text:
This lets you use magic the way a Unicorn does. 

This is only available if you are not already a Unicorn or a spellcasting race.

objects.title: Endless Well
objects.text: This one is rather simple; it increases your magic reserves. The greater your magic reserves, the more magic you can use and spells you can cast before getting tired.

objects.title: Ageless
objects.text:
Your biology is altered so that you will remain youthful. Should you have chosen an age other than adult, you will slowly age or regress towards your physical prime. 

This doesn't increase your toughness or physical ability aside from protecting you from the frailty of age.

You may not take this perk if you are a race that is already biologically immortal.

objects.title: Extra Strength
objects.text: Need some extra power in those muscles? This choice will grant you it. Pull out the strength of an Earth Pony even if you are a scrawny Unicorn.

objects.title: Durability
objects.text: Don't want to get hurt? Then this choice is for you. Increases your durability, significantly reducing damage taken from most sources.

objects.title: Wing Power
objects.text:
Or basically flight speed. This would improve a weak flier to someone that could challenge the Wonderbolts.

Requires a flying race.

objects.title: Run Forest Run!
objects.text: Increases your running speed on land. Go from a snail to a racing snail!

objects.title: Endurance
objects.text: Reduces your need for food, water, sleep, and more. You just keep going, and going, and going...

objects.title: Regeneration
objects.text: Your natural healing ability is supercharged. Serious injuries heal within a week, while regrowing lost limbs can take over a month.

objects.title: Pain Resistance
objects.text: You gain a resistance to pain. While you still feel the same amount of pain, it simple has less of an effect on you. Injuries that would be unbearable become as annoying as a papercut.

objects.title: Genius
objects.text:
You represent the mental apex of intelligence... and a little beyond.

Your creativity, critical thinking, and problem-solving skills all also get boosted. You're able to pick up and master new skills much quicker than most.

You also have a perfectly eidetic memory, capable of perfectly recalling anything that has happened to you.

objects.title: Determination
objects.text: Your determination is much greater. Your will is stronger. You just don't want to give up. Any mind-altering effect will be unable to influence you. You are also much more resistant to fear and intimidation.

objects.title: Well-Adjusted
objects.text:
You are a well-adjusted person.

Your personal issues are much easier to work through then they would be for anyone else, and even if you don’t have any help, you’ll be able to get through them in time.

You’re also really good at helping others through their issues, and it’ll stick more often than not as long as you can get through to them.

objects.title: Attractive
objects.text: Your body is just simply sculpted to near perfection. You are the picture of attractiveness for your race. A terrible choice if you don't like to be the center of attention.

objects.title: Charm
objects.text: Also, kinda charisma. It lets you charm and talk others into something much easier. You have that natural aura that surrounds you and makes others trust you more and consider your words more seriously. Technically, it can also work in reverse if you want to be more intimidating and feared.

objects.title: Lucky
objects.text: You live a more charmed life. Events are more likely to go your way and you casually avoid misfortune.

objects.title: Magical Eyes
objects.text: With these eyes, you will be able to see magical auras, allowing you to see if something is magical, and how powerful that magic by the density and strength of aura. This ability is togglable. A side effect of these eyes is that they faintly glow in the dark, giving you a minor night vision bonus.

objects.title: Cursed Body
objects.text:
Your body changes, allowing you to channel dark magic much easier and with more power. Surprisingly, it also lessens the strength of corruption upon your mind.

Be warned, this comes with obvious visual changes.

objects.title: Skills
objects.text:
Unlike the previous, the following perks are not intrinsic abilities, but instead learned skills. While this means you could learn them all yourself, each would take years, if not decades, of training. 

By purchasing these, you start out with them immediately, or learn them almost instinctively if you start as a newborn or foal.

objects.title: Combat
objects.text: You gain the necessary skills for combat, be it unarmed, with swords, spears, etc. This also includes basic magical combat skills for those with magic.

objects.title: Strategy
objects.text: Become a master planner. You will know when and how to execute your plans for best efficiency. Plus, you are great at chess.

objects.title: Survivalist
objects.text: You know how to live off the land and survive in the wilds. You could be dropped off anywhere in the world and still make your way to civilization. Or just live where you are.

objects.title: Parkour
objects.text: The ability to quickly and effectively move through unconventional paths, basically... Parkour! Run, jump, climb, and slide like a pro.

objects.title: Stealth
objects.text: This one lets you move lightly on your hooves, paws, claws, whatever. Move through shadows unnoticed and hide in plain sight.

objects.title: Potions
objects.text:
The Art of Potion making from the land of Zebrica. They can have a myriad of effects that range from healing potions that can cure many diseases and mend wounds, to deadly poisons that can kill even a grown manticore in seconds.

This perk is free if you are a Zebra.

objects.title: Master Craftsman
objects.text: You know a variety of physical crafting skills at a professional level, such as carpentry, smithing, sewing, electrical engineering, and more. You don't know any esoteric crafting skills, but you find it easy to learn new ones.

objects.title: Capitalist
objects.text: You have an innate skill for making money, bartering, and trading. You know how to run a business and can haggle with the best of them.

objects.title: Investigation
objects.text: You have all the skills necessary to be an investigator, except the knowledge of the law. This doesn't make you more perceptive, but it does make it so you know what to look for and how to think.

objects.title: Green "Thumb"
objects.text: You have in-depth knowledge of the growing and raising of many types of plants and crops. Your innate skill in this is also increased.

objects.title: Medic
objects.text: You have a nurse's level of knowledge and skill in medicine. You can set bones, stitch and bandage wounds, treat illnesses and more.

objects.title: Magic
objects.text:
There are many types of magic in the world. Some are simple, like levitation. Some are more complex like teleportation or transformation. And some dark, so dark that they stain the very soul of the caster.

Regardless, anything purchased here can be learned in the regular manner. You simply won't have the skills to start with.

objects.title: Levitation
objects.text:
Levitation magic lets you levitate items with your magic for as long as you have magic and can maintain relative focus. Controlling more items at once requires greater focus and control.

This magic is so basic and ubiquitous that it is free to purchase.

objects.title: Shield
objects.text: Create magical shields able to repel physical and magical attacks.

objects.title: Teleportation
objects.text: Teleport items and yourself across short and long distances.

objects.title: Healing
objects.text: Stop bleeding, mend flesh and bones, cure diseases and more!

objects.title: Element: Fire
objects.text:
Elemental school of fire.
It lets the user create and control flames and heat. You can throw fireballs, protect yourself from cold by creating a heat "shell" around yourself and more!

objects.title: Element: Air
objects.text:
Elemental school of air.
Create and control gusts of wind, wind blades, slow your fall and create small tornadoes, or control weather to some degree!

objects.title: Element: Water
objects.text: Elemental school of water. Conjure water from moisture in the air, control the tides, make deadly water blades and whips, and even generate and control ice.

objects.title: Element: Earth
objects.text: Elemental school of earth. Control rocks and earth, find minerals underground, and command nature itself.

objects.title: Illusion
objects.text: Create fake images, trick the senses of others, terrify your enemies with their own nightmares.

objects.title: Divination
objects.text: Divination is the magic of information, specifically the gaining of it. Scry the past, present, and even the future to learn what you seek.

objects.title: Transmutation
objects.text: Transmutation is a rather tough art, and often not permanent. It lets the user turn one thing into another, though it needs to be similar in mass, and the user needs to know exactly what the object is made of, and how it's going to change into another object.

objects.title: Transformation
objects.text:
Transformation magic lets the user become something else, or just change their mane style if they want. Again, this is highly regulated. Governments don't want criminals simply changing their appearance, right?

This magic is free for Changelings.

objects.title: Creation
objects.text: Create items and materials out of raw magic! Most of them are temporary, but with enough skill and practice you can make permanent items. There are of course laws to prevent magic users from creating excess wealth.

objects.title: Destruction
objects.text: The magic of destruction is highly regulated in Equestria, and for a good reason. A powerful Unicorn with mastery of destruction magic could basically Thanos snap someone out of existence. Although it's a bit more complicated than that, as you would need to consider magical resistance and many other factors, but it is technically possible.

objects.title: Enchanting
objects.text: Give items various magical effects, create magical golems or animated armors.

objects.title: Meta Magic
objects.text:
Meta magic by itself doesn't do much, but its power shines when combined with other types of magic.

Meta magic can combine spells to create a unique effect. It's also able to "read" spells, and tell you who used a spell on something, what that spell was, and how strong it was.

objects.title: Dark Magic
objects.text: Alright, here you need to be warned. Basically, all schools of magic here are illegal in one way or another, so don't go flaunting it around like it's a new bike or something, unless you want to gain some attention. And watch out for the corruption effect. Unless you have some way of shielding yourself, watch out how deep you delve into the dark arts lest you lose yourself.

objects.title: Dark Magic
objects.text:
Dark magic stains the soul of the caster in one way or another.

Power always comes at a price. Are you ready to pay it?

objects.title: Necromancy
objects.text: The Art of utilizing the forces of death. Raise and command the dead, fire bolts of necrotic energy, and commune with souls of the departed.

objects.title: Darkness
objects.text:
The Art of darkness. Sombra was a master of this art. Well, Sombra was a master of dark magic in general.

Magic of darkness can help you hide in shadows, shrug off most magic as your form becomes less physical. You can even control others through their shadows, and you are much stronger in the dark.

objects.title: Blood Magic
objects.text:
Blood magic is a really nasty thing, and that's not because of the blood itself. The effects of blood magic are really hard to counter. 

Blood magic can do a lot, it can even be a base for other dark magic spells. From simple spells to boil someone's blood inside their body, and even instantly stopping their heart, to combining the cursed arts with blood magic to create complex blood curses that will span generations.

objects.title: Cursed Arts
objects.text: The Arts of casting curses. By itself, it's nothing much, but combined with other dark arts it can have a myriad of effects. From cursing entire bloodlines when combined with blood magic, to making entire empire disappear into the shadow realm when combined with the art of darkness.

objects.title: Ritual Magic
objects.text:
The Ritual Arts are another base for other spells. Combined with other dark arts, rituals can greatly empower the effects of a spell, reduce its cost of casting and even change the spell altogether. 

Technically, the ritual arts can be used with normal spells as well but are considered dark magic because they always require some sort of sacrifice, often souls.

objects.title: Demonology
objects.text:
The Art of demonology.
Summoning demons to do your bidding. Making pacts, casting demonic spells, it's all here.

Users of demonology often make pacts with demons, selling their souls or souls of others in exchange for power or servitude. Pact with a demon is necessary to cast most demonic spells like hellfire or demonic aspects.

objects.title: Drawbacks
objects.text: Already out of points? Well don't worry. Here you have options to gain more, at a price of course.

objects.title: Low Magic Battery
objects.text:
Your species' innate magical gifts are weakened, and more quickly tire you out.

This can be overcome with training, but you will forever be behind the curve.

objects.title: Broke
objects.text:
To simply put it, you are broke.

But hey, money isn't everything!

Right?

objects.title: Nemesis
objects.text: Someone out there really hates your guts. They will try their best to destroy your life. But hey, it's Equestria, maybe you will be able to befriend them?

objects.title: Sickly
objects.text: You are prone to getting sick. Much more often than anyone else. Better invest in some good health care.

objects.title: Fated Enemy
objects.text: One of the villains gets a vision of you and is certain that they need to stop you before you can stop them. Good luck.

objects.title: Wrath of The Sun
objects.text: Celestia gets a vision of the future... well, a possible future. A future where you are THE villain that destroys Equestria. She intends to stop you in ANY way she deems necessary.

objects.title: Bait
objects.text:
For some reason, monsters are drawn to you. You are the greatest prey for them to hunt.

You better watch out.

objects.title: Worst Day Ever
objects.text:
Your first day in Equestria will be a doozy. The first 24 hours will be filled with chaos and misfortune. 

Taken once this will give you a serious case of bad luck. Taken all three times will make it feel as if the entire world is out to kill you.

objects.title: Beast Inside
objects.text: A dark spirit has latched onto your soul. It whispers into your mind demanding blood and carnage. The more negative emotions around you, the stronger it becomes. Light and harmonious magic will cause you pain, but dark magic will be twice as potent. Can you remain sane?

objects.title: Judgement Day
objects.text:
The gates of True Tartarus are open, and the demons are free. Their only goal is to convert the world into a demonic wasteland and devour the souls of mortals.

Judgement Day has come.

objects.title: Curse of the Lonely
objects.text: Whatever friends you make, will turn on you, or they will die, or maybe they weren't your friends after all. In the end, you are alone.

objects.title: They are Crazy
objects.text: If you ever tell anyone about your old life or your previous world, they will truly think that you are insane.

objects.title: Curse of the Traveler
objects.text:
There is a powerful curse placed on your soul. You cannot stay in one location for more than a week. If you do, then a disaster will strike that location.

A "location" counts as an area of 25 square kilometers.

objects.title: Dim
objects.text:
They say ignorance is bliss, which is why you seem so happy.

Your intellect is reduced, and you are more prone to forgetfulness. Your words will amuse and baffle those around you.

objects.title: Unlucky
objects.text: Things very often go wrong around you. You're frequently in the wrong place at the wrong time and getting yourself into situations by accident.

objects.title: "Odd"
objects.text:
You are suspicious.

Your outsider nature can be felt, and you get all the wrong kinds of attention. 

Expect to be treated like Zecora originally was.

objects.title: Conscious Geas
objects.text:
You have a geas on you. A geas is a compulsion you must obey.

You are aware of your geas and are not affected mentally by it, but if you try to go against the geas you won't be able to. It may make your body move on its own if you try to disobey.

objects.title: Unconscious Geas
objects.text:
You have a geas on you. A geas is a compulsion you must obey.

You are unaware of your geas, and its effects are entirely mental. The more general the geas is, the less it effects your personality, while a more specific geas has a greater, almost obsessive effect on you.

objects.title: Fresh Start
objects.text: You forget everything you know about Equestria. Regardless of your previous knowledge, you begin your new life with fresh eyes.

objects.title: Selective Amnesia
objects.text: You forget everything from your first life except your knowledge of Equestria. You don't remember your thoughts or feelings about Equestria, just the facts.

objects.title: Items
objects.text: Alright then! Need some gear? It will cost you some bits, though. Here, browse these wares to your heart's content.

objects.title: Bits
objects.text: What? You don't have enough money? If you have some excess points, you can exchange them for some bits, how does that sound?

objects.title: Survival Gear
objects.text: A bag of items to help you survive in the wild. A canteen, some rations, a map of Equestria, a compass, a small knife, flint and steel, some rope, a small roll of bandages, and some dry tinder sticks.

objects.title: Food Rations
objects.text:
Some extra food rations, enough to last a week.

They will be properly packaged and suited for your race.

objects.title: Potions
objects.text: Potions! Everyone likes potions, right? For few bits you can get three basic healing potions. They won't heal anything truly life-threatening, and they are not instantaneous, so watch out.

objects.title: Melee Weapon
objects.text: You can choose one non-magical melee weapon. It can be a sword, axe, spear or anything else.

objects.title: Ranged Weapon
objects.text: Choose one non-magical ranged weapon, be it a bow, crossbow, or a blowgun. If it's setting appropriate, like Modern AU, or Equestria at War, you can choose a gun.

objects.title: Armor
objects.text:
A set of non-magical steel armor.

Nothing special, but it can save your life.

objects.title: Special Armor
objects.text: Alright, here you can get a specialized armor of your design. It will be heavily enchanted to take a great deal of punishment and will be able to self-repair most damage. The enchantments will also render it basically weightless.

objects.title: Travelers Wagon
objects.text: A decent wagon, with enough space inside for a small bed, and place to keep your stuff. Cheaper than a house, and you can take it almost everywhere!

objects.title: Small House
objects.text:
This option gives you a small house in the location of your choosing. Don't worry, everything will be legal.

It has a bedroom, a bathroom, small kitchen, dining room and a basement.

objects.title: Toolkit
objects.text: A set of basic tools of your choosing. It can be anything, a blacksmith's kit, a tailor's kit, or maybe some tools for a thief. The choice is yours.

objects.title: Gems
objects.text: A small bag of gems, chosen specifically for their mana storage potential. You can fill them with magic for later use, or use them to power some enchantments or magical machinery.

objects.title: Clear Mind Amulet
objects.text: This amulet lets you keep your focus much easier. It also partially protects you from mind-altering effects and dark magic corruption.

objects.title: Memento
objects.text:
Some don't want to let go. For those people, this choice lets you keep one item from your previous life.

Be warned, Equestria may not have the technology or resources to maintain some items.
